<entry id="T00706">
<head-word>רֵיקָן</head-word>
<pos> m.</pos>
<senses>
<sense>
<definition> (v. 
<xref rid="T00700">ריקָם</xref>) 
<italic>empty</italic>.</definition>
<notes> Sabb. 83
<sup>b</sup>, a. e. מיטלטל מלא ור' is movable when filled as well as when empty. Ber. 40
<sup>a</sup> in the physical world כלי ר' מחזיק וכ' an empty vessel is receptive, a filled vessel is not; אבל הקב"ה … ר' אינו מחזיק not so with the Lord (in the spiritual world): a full vessel (mind) is receptive (of more), an empty one is not; a. fr.—Trnsf. 
<italic>bare of knowledge, ignorant</italic>. Cant. R. to IV, 4 (play on רקתך, ib. 3) הר' שבשלש … רצוף וכ' the least learned in the three rows (of scholars in front of the Sanhedrin) is as stuffed with knowledge as a pomegranate (is full of seeds). Ib. ר' שבישראל מלא וכ' an ignorant man in Israel is as full of argument &c.; Gen. R. s. 32 (not הריקין); a. fr.—
<plural-form>Pl. רֵיקָנִים, רֵיקָנִין</plural-form>. Cant. R. l. c. Ruth R. to III, 17 לא יצאו ר' they did not go out with empty hands; a. fr.—
<plural-form>Pl. רֵיקָנִית, רֵקָ'</plural-form>. Y. B. Kam. III, end, 3
<sup>d</sup> אחת ר' אחת טעונה one wagon (or ship) empty, and the other loaded. Yoma 53
<sup>a</sup> ביאה ר', v. בִּיאָה II.—Denom. רִיקֵן 
<italic>to empty, bare</italic>. Ukts. I, 3 זנב … שרִיקְנוֹ the skeleton of a cluster of grapes which one has stripped (of its grapes). Ib. 5 שרִיקְנָהּ, v. פְּסִיגָא. Ib. שרביט … שריקנו, v. שַׁרְבִיט.</notes></sense></senses></entry>

<entry id="T00715">

<definition />
<notes> Targ. I Sam. XXI, 14. Targ. Job VI, 6.—Keth. 77
<sup>b</sup> (describing רַאֲתָן) איתי ליה ר' וכ' slaver comes out of his mouth on which flies settle. Ḥull. 77
<sup>a</sup> דקני משכא רִירֵיה Ar. (v. Tosaf. a. l.; ed. דקנה משכא דידיה) when the skin over the fracture retains the discharge of the broken bone (ed. when the skin holds its own place). Ib. דקנא גרמא ריריה Mus. in Ar. ed. Koh. (ed. דידיה) when the broken bone retains its discharge. Bets. 22
<sup>a</sup> ר' discharge of a sore eye; Ab. Zar. 28
<sup>b</sup>.—
<plural-form>Pl. רִירִין</plural-form>. Y. Ter. VIII, 46
<sup>a</sup> top עברת ר' עלוי ופסקתיה (the serpent nibbling at the melon) passed slaver over it and cut through it (made the poison go through it).</notes></sense></senses></entry>

<entry id="T00718">

<sense>
<number>1)</number>
<definition>

<notes> Targ. Gen. XL, 16. Targ. O. Ex. XIV, 8, v. גְּלֵי. Ib. XXX, 23. Targ. Y. II Deut. XXXIII, 20 ראשא. 
<pgbrk id="pg1478" />Targ. I Chr. V, 12. Targ. Lev. V, 24; a. fr.—Y. Sabb. I, 4
<sup>a</sup> top אילולא … רֵישִׁי וכ' but for fear of putting my head between lions (v. אַרְיָא), I should have given a reason. Ḥull. 11
<sup>a</sup> (mixed dict.) ר' של עולה the head of a burnt-offering. Sabb. 55
<sup>a</sup> ר' דרֵישָׁךְ, v. חמִּים; Y. Nidd. III, 50
<sup>d</sup> רֵישֵׁיה דרישך, v. כָּוָה. M. Kat. 25
<sup>a</sup> לא הוה … רֵישִׁין מיניה we could not raise our head before him. Cant. R. to VII, 7 ראשה, v. נָבוֹז; a. v. fr.—ר' גלותא, ר' מתיבתא &c., v. respective determinants.—
<plural-form>Pl. רֵישִׁין, רֵישַׁיָּא, רֵישֵׁי, רָאשׁ'</plural-form>. Targ. Deut. I, 13. Targ. Is. IX, 9 (some ed. רָשַׁ', רַשַּׁ'). Targ. Gen. II, 10; a. fr.—Men. 37
<sup>a</sup> אתיליד … תרי ר' a child with two heads was born to me. Y. Sabb. VII, 10
<sup>a</sup> bot. כד מפרכייא ברָאשַׁיָּיא when she crushes the heads of onions. Gen. R. s. 61 רָאשֵׁי אומין chiefs of nations. Y. Sabb. IV, 7
<sup>a</sup> top תחותי רֵשֵׁיכוֹן (not תוחתי רשיבון) under your heads; a. fr.—V. רֵישְׁתָּא.</notes></sense>
<sense>
<number>—2)</number>
<definition>
<italic>beginning, first thing, firstling</italic>.</definition>
<notes> Targ. O. Deut. XI, 12. Targ. Prov. VIII, 2. Targ. O. Num. XV, 20; a. fr.—ר' ירחא, ר' שתא &c., v. respective determinants.—מר' 
<italic>at first, formerly</italic>. Ḥull. 105
<sup>b</sup> מר' הוה אמינא וכ' formerly I thought &c. Keth. 105
<sup>b</sup>; a. fr.—Esp. רישא 
<italic>the first clause</italic> of a Mishnah, a verse &c. Ḥull. 94
<sup>b</sup>. Sabb. 86
<sup>a</sup>; a. fr., v. סֵיפָא, a. מְצִיעֲתָא.—(רֹאשׁ) רֵישׁ מַיָּא pr. n. pl. 
<italic>Resh Maya (Spring)</italic>. Tosef. Shebi. IV, 11, a. e., v. גַּעְתּוֹן.</notes></sense></senses></entry>

<sense>
<number>1)</number>

<xref rid="K00449">כֹּחַ</xref>.</definition>
<notes> Ab. II, 9 חבר רע a bad companion; לב רע a bad heart; a. v. fr.—
<italic>Fem.</italic> רָעָה 
<italic>bad</italic>; (noun) 
<italic>evil</italic>. Ib., a. fr. עין ר', v. עַיִן. Sabb. 11
<sup>a</sup> כל ד' ולא אשה ר' any evil, only not a bad wife. Ber. 61
<sup>a</sup> אחת … ואחת יועצתו לר' one (kidney) counsels for good, the other for evil. Y. Shek. I, beg. 45
<sup>d</sup> לטובה … לר' וכ' for a good purpose—‘every liberal-hearted’ (Ex. XXXV, 2</notes></sense>
<sense>
<number>2)</number>
<definition>, for a bad purpose—‘the whole people’ (ib. XXXII, 3). Hor. 10
<sup>b</sup> אפי' טובתם … ר' היא וכ' even the good which wicked men do is an evil with the righteous (they do not enjoy it); Yeb. 103
<sup>a</sup> sq.</definition>
<notes> Koh. R. to V, 12, v. חוֹלָה I. Ber. l. c. (ref. to Koh. IV, 17) אל תהי … אם על ר' הם מביאים be not like the fools who sin and offer a sacrifice, not knowing whether they offer it for the good they have done or for the evil; a. v. fr.—
<plural-form>Pl. רָעִים; רָעוֹת</plural-form>. Keth. 110
<sup>b</sup> (quot. fr. Ben Sira) כל ימי עני ר' all the days of a poor man are bad; Snh. 101
<sup>a</sup>. Y. Ber. V, 8
<sup>d</sup> bot., v. חָצַף. Ex. R. s. 42 (ref. to Jer. II, 1</notes></sense>
<sense>
<number>3)</number>
<definition />
<notes> ושתי ר' עשו לבד have they committed no more than two evils?; a. v. fr.</notes></sense></senses></entry>
